final_response: Replied to Priya's urgent API timeout complaint email. The reply acknowledges the issue, apologizes for the disruption, asks for specific technical details (error messages, timestamps, affected endpoints), and confirms the issue is being treated with high priority. Email marked as read.

args.body:
Hi Priya,

Thank you for reporting the API timeout issue. I understand this is blocking your users and I apologize for the disruption.

We are investigating the root cause and will provide an update shortly. Could you share any specific error messages, timestamps, or endpoints that are most affected? This will help us prioritize the fix.

We're treating this with high priority and will work to resolve it as quickly as possible.

Best regards
